caption:
Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

Surah Fatir (35:2). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #IslamicReminder #Ayah #Deen #IslamicGuidance

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-26) of GET /v1/ayah/35:2/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Raw: "无论真主赏赐你们什么恩惠，绝无人能加以阻拦；无论他扣留什么恩惠，在禁施之后，绝无人能加以开释。他确是万能的，确是至睿的。". Used verbatim.
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "하나님께서 그분의 자비로 인류를 위해 보내신 그 은혜를 누 구도 제재할 수 없으며 또한 그분께서 제지하신 것을 누구도 자유 롭게 할 수 없나니 그분은 권능과지혜로 충만하심이라". Spacing-only fix: '누 구도' -> '누구도'; '자유 롭게' -> '자유롭게'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "アッラーが人間に与えられるどんな慈悲も，阻まれることはない。またかれが阻む何事も，それを解き放すものはない。本当にかれは偉力ならびなく英明であられる。"
